name: Forest Goblin Magic
notes: Used by the Forest Goblin Shaman. Judgement calls: Wind of Gork's Toughness test left as a roll-under test, with its S2 hit doubled to S4; 'Eadbanger bolts use the Shaman's Toughness as Strength (unchanged); the 1 on the backfire roll becomes 1-2.

spells.name: Wind of Gork
spells.text: Range 12". The first model in its path must roll under its Toughness or take a Strength 4 hit and be knocked down automatically.

spells.name: Gaze of Mork
spells.text: Range 12". D3 Strength 6 hits strike the first model in their path.

spells.name: 'Eadbanger
spells.text: Range 6". Fire a number of bolts equal to the Shaman's Attacks, each resolved with Strength equal to the Shaman's Toughness, at the first model in their path. After the bolts are resolved, roll a die; on a 1-2 the Shaman collapses and goes out of action.

spells.name: Leap of Waaagh!
spells.text: The Shaman or any other Goblin within 3" may be moved up to 12". If this brings them into close combat they count as charging in the close combat phase.

spells.name: Idol of Gork
spells.text: The Shaman gains +2 WS, +2 S and +1 A until the Shaman takes a wound.

spells.name: 'Ere we go!
spells.text: All friendly models within 6" of the Shaman treat stunned results on the injury table as knocked down instead. Lasts until the Shaman takes a wound.
